doc_title_en: Notice on Results of Tender Offer for Nissin Shoji Shares by EDIAND Co., Ltd. and Changes in Parent Company and Lead Major Shareholder
doc_title_jp: 株式会社EDIANDによる当社株式に対する公開買付けの結果並びに親会社及び主要株主である筆頭株主の異動に関するお知らせ
summary_en: EDIAND completed tender offer for Nissin Shoji shares (2026-05-12 to 2026-06-22). 3,921,070 shares tendered, exceeding minimum threshold of 2,291,500. EDIAND to acquire all tendered shares, becoming parent company and lead major shareholder with 58.73% voting control as of 2026-06-29 settlement. CEO Tsutui Hiroaki (EDIAND representative) owned 3.30% of Nissin directly pre-offer.
summary_jp: EDIAND が日新商事の公開買付完了（2026-05-12～2026-06-22）。3,921,070 株応募、下限 2,291,500 株超過。EDIAND が全応募株を取得、2026-06-29 決済で親会社・筆頭株主に、議決権 58.73% 保有。CEO 筒井博昭は事前に 3.30% 直接保有。
tag_en: MBO – EDIAND acquires 3,921,070 shares (58.73% voting) via tender offer – settlement 2026-06-29
tag_jp: MBO – EDIAND が公開買付で 3,921,070 株取得（議決権 58.73%）– 決済日 2026-06-29
